items.title: Elemental Teens

items.description:
Water. Earth. Fire. Air. These teens are inspired by the 4 elements!
Become a water bender or an air bender! Add these 16 skins to your collection!

-Includes 16 elemental skins
-By: Black Arts Studios

items.title: Famous Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Shine like the stars! These skins includes a variety of rich and fashionable designs that are perfect to show off to friends. Live your dream life and show off your style as one of these famous teens!

- Roleplay with 8 different skins!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Xenon Design.

items.title: Infinity Lucky Block Skyblock
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Explore this lucky block skyblock map to infinity and beyond! The map will automatically generate new islands for you to explore and find lucky blocks on!

- Open lucky blocks to find items and gear (you can even get an airplane as loot!)
- 100+ unique islands
- Multiplayer friendly

items.title: Cool Summer Teens
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Are you ready for this summer? After a long year, these teens are ready to stretch at the beach, play sports, and just enjoy some vitamin D! So get ready to leave your rooms, put on your sneakers and enjoy the great outdoors. Show your love for the sun, t-shirts and finally being able to see your friends with the Cool Summer Teens skin pack.

~10 summer-ready teens

items.title: Neon Anime
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Dye your hair a vibrant neon color with these stylish anime teen skins!

+ 12 cool teen skins
+ Awesome streetwear outfits

items.title: Pirate Discovery
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Your fellow pirates discovered these lost lands known to contain many treasures! Help them explore the land for treasures and beyond!

+ Many boats
+ Fluffy mushroom houses
+ Many biomes
+ By Street Studios

items.title: Trendy Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
These skins are trendy! Find the next best cute, modern clothes for teens in this awesome pack! These are the perfect styles for any situation and look great all year round. A modern teen needs fashionable clothes and styles like masks, demon horns, and colorful gradients!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 in total cute, teen skins
+ Includes modern attire!

items.title: Anime Masked Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Wear an anime masked skin now and impress everyone with your style! Don't wait any longer, and choose between one of these 12 awesome skins!

- 1 free skin!
- Perfect for roleplay!
- By Pixelusion & PixelSoft Studios

items.title: Gazillionaire
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Millionaires, billionaires, and even trillionaires are so yesterday. The true elites are gazillionaires. Earn your fortune the fun way. Fly through rings with a jetpack, play golf, or race around the track. Find one million dollar bills and become the richest person in the world! Explore this exclusive private island.
- 10 mansions
- 14 vehicles
- 5 skins

Live it large!

items.title: Changer Bots
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Change cars, trucks, and planes into robots! Use their robot abilities to save the city from giant mobs. Quantum Cream is an ice cream truck that shoots portals. Metal Monster is a monster truck that transforms into a spider. Fly Dark Star as a plane or change it into a mech suit.
- 8 changer bots
- Epic animations
- 5 skins
- Single or multiplayer

Changer bots, ride out!

items.title: TreeHouse: Noob x Pro x Hacker
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description: Everyone loves a treehouse, it's your own little home in the wilderness. Here you can find examples of epic treehouses that a noob, a pro and even a hacker can make in Minecraft! Which one is you?

items.title: Ninja Zombie
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Have you ever dreamt of being a ninja zombie? This is your chance to be one! According to the latest reports the zombies have arrived in the cities, so what are you waiting for? Go join them! Enjoy these ten awesome skins for you and your friends. 

- 10 ninja zombie skins.
- One totally free skin.
- Created by DragonClub Studios.
